related.title: QAOA：單邊 Max-Cut 的角度景觀
related.titleEn: QAOA: the angle landscape of a single-edge Max-Cut
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：只在量測項獨立與變異數估計可信時套此分配；報告估計偏差與統計誤差分開。 另一位學徒須能從輸入與算式重算，而非僅讀結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Use the allocation only with independent terms and credible variances, reporting bias separately from sampling uncertainty. A second learner must be able to reconstruct the result from inputs and equations.
related.difference: 用可解析的兩量子位元案例檢查成本符號、角度和最佳化器。
related.differenceEn: Use an analytic two-qubit case to check cost signs, angles and the optimizer.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。a=1、b=2，總900shots，先均分nP=nQ=450；能量用教學單位。 Var(E)=1/450+4/450。 代入 1/450+4/450，得到 0.0111111 energy-unit squared。獨立量測E=a⟨P⟩+b⟨Q⟩時Var(E)=a²Var(P)/nP+b²Var(Q)/nQ；此例兩項單次變異數均1。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。

以下情境參數為合成教學輸入，並非案例設備實測或廠商規格；光速、波茲曼常數等標準物理常數另依名稱與單位標明。β=π/8、γ=π/2，單邊權重1，無雜訊。 ⟨C⟩=[1+sin(π/2)sin(π/2)]/2。 代入 (1+sin(4*pi/8)*sin(pi/2))/2，得到 1 expected cut weight。初態|++⟩，C=(1−Z₁Z₂)/2、UC=e^−iγC、UB=e^−iβ(X₁+X₂)，p=1時⟨C⟩=[1+sin(4β)sinγ]/2。 將式子拆成至少兩個中間欄，逐欄保留單位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. a=1,b=2,total900 shots, initially450 each; use teaching energy units. Var(E)=1/450+4/450. Substituting 1/450+4/450 gives 0.0111111 energy-unit squared. For independentE=a⟨P⟩+b⟨Q⟩,Var(E)=a²Var(P)/nP+b²Var(Q)/nQ; both single-shot variances are1 here. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.

Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. β=π/8,γ=π/2,one unit-weight edge and no noise. ⟨C⟩=[1+sin(π/2)sin(π/2)]/2. Substituting (1+sin(4*pi/8)*sin(pi/2))/2 gives 1 expected cut weight. For|++⟩,C=(1−Z1Z2)/2,UC=e^-iγC,UB=e^-iβ(X1+X2),p=1 gives⟨C⟩=[1+sin(4β)sinγ]/2. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Google 超導 QPU：非諧性與選頻洩漏
related.titleEn: Google superconducting QPU: anharmonicity and off-resonant leakage
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：只在量測項獨立與變異數估計可信時套此分配；報告估計偏差與統計誤差分開。 另一位學徒須能從輸入與算式重算，而非僅讀結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Use the allocation only with independent terms and credible variances, reporting bias separately from sampling uncertainty. A second learner must be able to reconstruct the result from inputs and equations.
related.difference: 建立『Google 超導 QPU：非諧性與選頻洩漏』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付洩漏與時間雙軸比較、初態基線及三能階模型升級需求。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'Google superconducting QPU: anharmonicity and off-resonant leakage', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver a leakage/time comparison, initial-state baseline and requirements for a three-level model.

先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：用弱驅動上界代理 L=(Ω/Δ)²；Ω與非目標失諧Δ同單位。此值不是完整三能階門誤差。 使用合成Ω/2π=10 MHz、非目標Δ/2π=200 MHz，取比值時2π抵消。 以手算或試算表計算名義式(10/200)**2，另開一欄執行獨立核對：檢查振幅減半使平方代理減至四分之一，而不是一半；另列退相干時間尚未納入。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Scenario parameters below are synthetic teaching inputs, not measurements or specifications of the named device; standard physical constants such as the speed of light and Boltzmann constant are identified separately by name and unit. a=1,b=2,total900 shots, initially450 each; use teaching energy units. Var(E)=1/450+4/450. Substituting 1/450+4/450 gives 0.0111111 energy-unit squared. For independentE=a⟨P⟩+b⟨Q⟩,Var(E)=a²Var(P)/nP+b²Var(Q)/nQ; both single-shot variances are1 here. Split the expression into at least two intermediate columns and retain their units.

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Use weak-drive proxy L=(Ω/Δ)² with matching frequency units; it is not a complete three-level gate error. Use Synthetic Ω/2π=10 MHz and unwanted Δ/2π=200 MHz;2π cancels in the ratio. Evaluate nominal expression (10/200)**2 by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Check that halving amplitude quarters the squared proxy; separately list omitted decoherence time.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
